events.title: CVE-2026-94127: F5 BIG-IP APM F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
events.summary: F5 BIG-IP APM has a heap-based buffer overflow that can be triggered when an access policy and OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution.
events.why_it_matters: The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.3 and is listed on the KEV, indicating it is a high-risk, potentially exploited flaw. Defenders should prioritize patching F5 BIG-IP APM instances that use access policies and OAuth profiles on virtual servers.

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-94127 as exploited in the wild, added 2026-09-22, with US federal agencies due to fix it by 2026-09-25.
CVE-2026-94127 is rated 9.3 (critical) under CVSS 4.0 by the CNA that assigned it.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-94127 being exploited in the next 30 days at 2.2%.
2 independent sources report this event.

timeline.summary: First reported by CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities
Also reported by Rapid7 Cybersecurity Blog
watchTowr Labs published a public proof-of-concept exploit repository for the pre-auth BIG-IP APM RCE, with hardcoded offsets for a specific BIG-IP 21.1.0 build.

events.title: CISA Adds Two Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
events.summary: CISA added two Citrix NetScaler vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772) to its KEV catalog after evidence of active exploitation.
events.why_it_matters: Both vulnerabilities have a CVSS score of 9.5 and are actively exploited, posing a high risk to federal systems that use Citrix NetScaler. Defenders should prioritize patching and monitoring these assets.

claims.text: CISA lists CVE-2026-5430, CVE-2026-65660, CVE-2026-67279, CVE-2026-71362 and 6 more as exploited in the wild.
CVE-2026-5430 is rated 10.0 (critical) under CVSS 3.1 by the CNA that assigned it, the highest of the 10 scored CVEs here.
FIRST's EPSS puts the chance of CVE-2026-71362 being exploited in the next 30 days at 88%, the highest of the 10 CVEs here.

timeline.summary: CISA Advisories added CVE-2026-5430, CVE-2026-71362
CISA Advisories added CVE-2026-65660, CVE-2026-67279
First reported by CISA Advisories
Australia's ACSC updated its critical alert on 30 September, reporting that it has received reports from Australian organisations confirming exploitation of the NetScaler ADC and Gateway flaws.
CISA added a third Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 4 October, citing evidence of active exploitation.
Citrix released emergency NetScaler ADC and Gateway updates on 4 October to fix a newly exploited SAML-related denial-of-service zero-day, alongside global deny-list mitigations.

events.title: Siemens Industrial Edge Management
events.summary: Siemens Industrial Edge Management software has an authentication bypass that lets attackers reset credentials and take over accounts without email verification. Siemens released patches for affected versions.
events.why_it_matters: The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.1 and is rated critical, meaning attackers can fully compromise accounts. Defenders should update to the latest versions immediately to prevent account takeover.

reasons: Global vulnerability with no Australian detail

events.title: CVE-2026-93952: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
events.summary: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem has a critical improper input validation flaw that could let a remote attacker gain privileged access and compromise the orchestrator and its data.
events.why_it_matters: The flaw has a CVSS score of 9.5 and is listed in the KEV, indicating it is a high-risk vulnerability that could allow attackers to gain privileged access to the orchestrator and its data.
